prompt: A train leaves City A at 09:15 traveling 72 km/h toward City B 288 km away. A second train leaves City B at 09:45 toward City A at 96 km/h. At what clock time do they meet? Show each step: distance remaining when the second train starts, relative speed, time to meet, then absolute clock time.

Solve step by step: a tank is 3/5 full. After removing 48 liters it is half full. Find the tank capacity, then how many liters are needed to fill it completely from the half-full state, then the percentage of capacity that 48 liters represents.

Compound interest: principal $12,000 at 6.5% compounded annually for 3 years. Compute year-by-year balance, total interest earned, and the effective yield as a percent of principal. Show formulas before plugging numbers.
Probability: an urn has 5 red, 4 blue, 3 green balls. Draw 3 without replacement. Compute P(all different colors), P(exactly 2 red), and P(no green). Show combinations used for each.
Optimization: minimize cost C = 4x + 6y subject to x + 2y >= 10, 3x + y >= 12, x >= 0, y >= 0. Identify corner points of the feasible region, evaluate C at each, and state the optimal (x, y, C).

Explain why this Python snippet can raise RuntimeError and how to fix it without changing the public API. def fetch_all(ids): results = []; for i in ids: results.append(cache[i] if i in cache else load(i)); return results. Assume cache is a shared dict mutated by another thread. Walk through race conditions and propose a concrete patch.

A FastAPI endpoint returns 500 intermittently: async def get_user(uid: str): row = await db.fetchrow('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=$1', uid); return {'email': row['email'].lower()}. Diagnose null/missing-row cases, pool exhaustion, and recommend defensive checks plus logging. Provide a corrected function body.

This Go fanIn leaks goroutines under load when ctx is cancelled. Explain the leak, missing cancellation, and channel close protocol. Rewrite a correct version that respects context.Context and closes out when all inputs drain or ctx ends.

React component re-fetches forever because useEffect depends on an inline object { userId }. Explain the dependency bug, why the object recreates each render, give the corrected hook, and list two other anti-patterns that cause fetch loops.

SQL is slow on 50M-row orders: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY customer_id. Explain why DATE(created_at) defeats indexes, rewrite a sargable UTC-today predicate, propose an index, and estimate plan changes.

You are an SRE agent planning a zero-downtime migration of a Postgres primary from amd64 to arm64 Axion. Produce a phased plan: prechecks, logical replication strategy, cutover gates, rollback triggers, and validation queries. Include estimated risk per phase.

Design a multi-agent workflow for a customer-support triage bot: ingest ticket, classify intent, retrieve KB snippets, draft reply, escalate if confidence < 0.8. Specify tools per step, failure modes, token budget hints, and an ASCII sequence diagram.

Plan a 2-week rollout of speculative decoding (draft=tier1, verify=tier3) in production. Cover canary metrics (acceptance rate, p99 latency, token savings), abort criteria, config flags, and on-call runbook bullets. Be concrete and ordered.

An agent must debug a failing CI job that only fails on aarch64. Outline investigation steps: reproduce locally, compare glibc/CPU feature flags, isolate flaky tests, collect artifacts, propose fixes ranked by likelihood. Include commands you would run.

Create a capacity plan for a 3-tier llama-server fleet (0.5B / 3B / 8B) serving 200 concurrent agent sessions with 30% escalation to tier3. Estimate QPS per tier, KV RAM pressure risks, and when to add nodes. Show assumptions and formulas.
